title: Torpedo Run
description: The bosses have sent for their closers. A Torpedo is a Syndicate elite with a tommy gun and no conversation — the man they call when a street stops paying. Two of them are working Ashmoor now, and the sergeant won't pretend a lone hand can walk up on that fire. Bring friends or bring cunning, but bring the Torpedoes down before they turn the High Street into a shooting gallery.
location_hint: Ashmoor High Street, in the open
